messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The document type selection is unresponsive, forcing the user to click it repeatedly before they can save.
  quote: click "Document type", rage x5 ... click "Save"
- problem: The task requires clicking Details then Save, which is frustrating and inefficient.
  quote: Tasks: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The document type selection requires excessive clicking.
  quote: click "Document type", rage x5
- problem: Users get frustrated because opening and saving documents doesn't work properly.
  quote: Documents: click "Open" ... click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The document type selector is difficult to use, requiring multiple clicks.
  quote: Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
